title: WiseTech says Australian police took no action against founder Richard White after probing allegations he exploited a woman's immigration status for sex (Angus Whitley/Bloomberg)
summary: Angus Whitley / Bloomberg: WiseTech says Australian police took no action against founder Richard White after probing allegations he exploited a woman's immigration status for sex — WiseTech Global Ltd. said Australian police ended an investigation and took no action against founder Richard White …
